purpose: Let a learner read the available current-user global activity stream through the native CLI, including later pages supplied by Canvas, with complete-read failure behavior.

publicInterface.mcp: Existing canvas_activity_stream delegate remains byte-identical and inherits the API result.

behavior: Use the existing CanvasClient.get_paginated for this endpoint; do not create a second pagination implementation.

Preserve each returned item's complete decoded payload, unknown fields, nested values, original page/row order and duplicate identities. Do not sort, normalize, deduplicate, rank, infer unread state or fetch linked content.

Apply no new course, date, read-state, active-course or result-count filter. The client's original per_page default, opaque continuation URL handling, same-origin guard, token/session/fixture routing and 40-page bound remain authoritative.
A terminal response ends traversal without an extra empty-page probe. A continuing short or empty page follows its valid next link.

An authentication/HTTP/pagination/JSON-decoding failure, invalid continuation, repeated URL, continuing non-list body or known continuation after 40 pages propagates through the API; do not return previously collected pages as success.

Preserve the generic client's first terminal single-resource convention: a first terminal object/scalar is wrapped as one list entry; fixture behavior is unchanged. This change adds no stricter activity-item schema.
CLI waits for the API result before stdout, then prints that result using the existing JSON style: indent=2, default=str, trailing newline.

Within the new activity dispatch, CanvasAuthError, CanvasPaginationError, httpx.HTTPError and ValueError produce exit1, empty successful stdout and one JSON error object on stderr with ok=false, error class name and message.
During the activity read, suppress ordinary HTTPX request logging and restore the exact caller's HTTPX logger level on success or failure. Preserve the existing API/client close path.
Unknown activity arguments are rejected by argparse before CanvasClient construction. The new command makes no independent account/profile/broker setup changes.
No Canvas write, mark-read, hide/delete, subscription, provider/model request, browser launch or linked-resource fetch is introduced. Native qualification uses authored loopback/fixture data only.
limitations: This is the available Canvas activity-stream collection, not a full historical archive, complete assignment inventory, count of all unread work or proof of message-body completeness.
The primary API documents truncation of some activity message types at 4KB. This reader preserves received payloads; it does not recover omitted source text.
Native fixture/loopback receiving does not establish live school authentication, live unread-state behavior or student outcomes.
Generic client validation and native JSON serialization remain unchanged; no new validation promise is made for arbitrary provider scalar values.
Actual required hosted gates remain unrun under the no-Actions hold.

modify.src/canvaspilot/api.py: Only existing activity_stream method body; preserve no-argument signature and every other body.
modify.src/canvaspilot/cli.py: Only additive activity parser and dispatch spans; preserve all existing commands.
modify.README.md: One additive activity section or pointer.

excluded: existing assignment/page search and inbox/discussion export source

primaryReferences.basis: Official activity-stream endpoint is paginated; heterogeneous records and endpoint message truncation are documented.
Existing client's opaque Link pagination contract remains authoritative.

nativeEnvironment.dependencyUse: Existing environment read-only; -B/PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE, own source and own temporary roots. No installs or peer cleanup.

executionBoundary.independentReceiver: /root — freeze independent expectations before candidate exposure
executionBoundary.actionsHold: Jacob-Met/hamon#143 comment6067592767; no dispatch, rerun or triggering push/PR/merge

receivingIntent: Actual native original before-image, including omitted configured later page and missing activity CLI command
Real token loopback pages, exact payload preservation and terminal controls
Initial/later errors and pagination failure with no partial CLI success
Logger restoration, client close and argument admission
Unchanged MCP delegation using installed SDK where available
Original source/tree preservation and meaningful existing tests
